IBPS RRB XV 15th Scale-I, II, III Online Form 2026 (13706 Posts) - Complete Details

Short Information : Institute Of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released a Notification for the recruitment of IBPS RRB Bank Officer Scale-I, II, III Post on the official website of the IBPS. This recruitment has been issued for 13706 posts. Online applying process for IBPS RRB XV 15th Scale-I, II, III Recruitment 2026 has Started from 01 September 2026 &  candidate can apply till 21 September 2026. Candidates must check complete details for IBPS RRB XV 15th Officer Scale-I, II, III Recruitment 2026.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date : 01 September 2026
  • Last Date for Registration : 21 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 September 2026
  • PET Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Pre Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Notify Soon
  • Result : Notify Soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 175/-
  • PH : Rs. 175/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
